name: Skull-shaped dish
label: Dishes
lead: Skull-shaped dish with an opening on top - for food, water or a small plant, for a terrarium with a dark, desert or Halloween look.

description.html: The skull-shaped dish is one of the most striking pieces in our range. A realistically shaped skull in ochre-beige with brown shading has an opening on top of the head, while deep eye sockets and teeth make it look like a real desert find.

It can be used for food, for water or as a pot for a small plant. Planted with a succulent or a trailing plant it becomes an eye-catching decoration in any terrarium. As a food or water dish it fits well in desert setups with sand, rocks and dry branches.

If you put a plant in it, choose a species that is not toxic to your animal and a substrate that does not hold too much water. If you use it for water or food, change the contents every day and check that leftovers do not collect in the hollows of the face. Place the skull on a level surface so it stands firmly, especially if the terrarium houses animals that climb and push decorations around.
